name: Robot action validator
problem: Reject malformed and out-of-workspace model actions before a simulator executes them.
limits: Synthetic actions only; strict schema and finite coordinate bounds. PyBullet dry run uses a kinematic point robot, not collision planning or a hardware safety certification. Baseline passes every malformed input through (failure rate in bench.json); the guarded path rejects them. The recorded gate-failure.log demonstrates that unsafe baseline failing the same corpus. Replay compares accepted positions and rejected decisions. Coverage is for this seeded corpus, not all possible inputs.
next: Add articulated arm collision checks and simulator-version migration tests.
